title: ny fed / liberty street economics / repo market | Blog Post | The Fed Has Two Tools to Influence Money Market Conditions
summary: NY Fed staff researchers Adam Copeland and Owen Engbretson analyze how two Fed monetary policy tools—administrative rates (IORB) and balance sheet size (Fed liabilities)—affect money market conditions using confidential trade-level Treasury repo data from OFR. Their empirical estimates show both tools significantly influence the liquidity risk premium that dealers charge to intermediate funding, with IORB increases and Fed liability decreases driving up spreads. The average dealer spread to intermediate funding was 7.5 basis points during the 2020-2024 sample period.
